resources.string: Declarative UI toolkit, including Material 3, icons, adaptive navigation, previews and UI testing.
Android compatibility helpers, Kotlin extensions and the splash screen API.
Activity lifecycle, activity result APIs and integration with Compose.
Backward-compatible Android components, themes and application locale support.
Lifecycle-aware state collection and ViewModels, with Compose and Navigation 3 integration.
Compose navigation with application-owned back stacks and entry state management.
Loads large lists in pages and integrates paging state with Compose.
Custom Tabs support for opening web pages with browser capabilities.
Constraint-based layouts for Android views and Compose.
Camera preview, capture, video, lifecycle binding, viewfinders and device extensions.
Reads and writes image metadata such as orientation and capture details.
Compile-time dependency injection, Android lifecycle integration and generated dependency wiring.
Connects Hilt-injected ViewModels to Jetpack and Compose.
Compose helpers for observing and requesting Android runtime permissions.
Image loading and caching for Compose, with an OkHttp network backend.
Type-safe HTTP API definitions, suspend calls and Gson response conversion.
HTTP client with connection reuse, caching, interceptors and TLS support.
Converts Java and Kotlin data objects to and from JSON.
Programming language, standard library and compiler plugins used by the application.
Structured asynchronous work, Flow streams and coroutine testing utilities.
Compiler-assisted serialization for JSON data and typed navigation routes.
Compile-time annotations that document managed coroutine scope ownership.
Memory leak detection in debug builds, including Android Studio profiler integration.
Unit testing framework for assertions, test fixtures and regression tests.
Android device instrumentation, JUnit integration and UI interaction testing.
Processes Kotlin symbols at build time to generate code for libraries such as Hilt.
Build automation used to compile, test and package the application.
